title: Neurai-VN Benchmark: Standardized Machine Learning Models for Multimodal Digital Phenotyping in Mental Health Classification
abstract: arXiv:2607.25232v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Digital phenotyping (DP) using smartphones and wearable devices has emerged as a promising approach for assessing mental health, particularly depression and anxiety. However, progress remains difficult to evaluate because of heterogeneity across datasets and inconsistencies in preprocessing pipelines. In this work, we introduce a reproducible machine learning benchmark using the Neurai-VN dataset, a multimodal digital phenotyping dataset collected from 100 Vietnamese adults over two weeks. We define four binary classification tasks evaluated using standardized subject-wise cross-validation. Representative linear, tree-based, and neural baseline models are evaluated systematically across predefined feature-group configurations. translated_title: Neurai-VN基准：面向心理健康分类的多模态数字表型标准化机器学习模型
translated_abstract: 摘要：利用智能手机和可穿戴设备的数字表型（DP）已成为评估心理健康（尤其是抑郁和焦虑）的一种有前景的方法。然而，由于数据集之间的异质性和预处理流程的不一致性，进展评估仍面临困难。在本研究中，我们引入了一个可复现的机器学习基准，使用Neurai-VN数据集，这是一个从100名越南成年人中收集的两周多模态数字表型数据集。我们定义了四个二分类任务，并使用标准化的受试者级交叉验证进行评估。代表性的线性、基于树和神经基线模型在预定义的特征组配置下进行了系统性评估。五个交叉验证折的平均受试者级F1分数在健康对照与抑郁症以及健康对照与临床组中达到0.71，而健康对照与焦虑症以及抑郁症与焦虑症则达到...
tldr: 本文提出了一个基于Neurai-VN数据集的可复现机器学习基准，通过标准化交叉验证和多种基线模型，有效评估了多模态数字表型在心理健康分类中的性能，其中健康对照与抑郁症分类的F1分数达到0.71。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a reproducible machine learning benchmark using the Neurai-VN dataset, systematically evaluating multimodal digital phenotyping for mental health classification with standardized cross-validation, achieving an F1 score of 0.71 for healthy control vs. depression.
